_comment: The wording of the automated presenter-reminder emails.
A chapter rewords any of these by putting the same key in its own emails/reminders.json - keys it leaves out keep the core wording, and pick up core improvements.
{{double braces}} are filled in at BUILD time from chapter.json: chapter, chapter_short, tagline, tagline_words, contact, weekday, deadline_who, deadline_time, deadline_weekday, playlist_day.
{single braces} are filled in when each email is SENT: when, title, n, date, one, files, edu, playlist, roster.
Write HTML. The plain-text version of every email is made from it automatically.
A value can be a list of lines; they are joined with newlines.
reminder_files: Open your slides and notes
reminder_notes: The speaker notes in there have timings, the story prompts and what to cut
if the meeting runs late. They are prompts, not a script: say it in your own
words. The whole program is on the chapter education page.
reminder_playlist: Your closing slide has a QR code for the chapter playlist
— worth pointing at it, it is where this week's CEU hour lives.
deadline_today: Changing the slides? Today is the day. Your deck is
already with {{deadline_who}}, so if you are happy with it there is
nothing to do. If you are changing anything, the new .pptx has to reach
{{deadline_who}} by {{deadline_time}} today — after that the meeting deck is
built and the version already in it is the one that runs.
deadline_normal: to send, nothing to chase. If you would rather change them, that part is
yours: get the new .pptx to {{deadline_who}} by {{deadline_time}} on the {{deadline_weekday}}
before, or the version already in the meeting deck is the one that runs.
cant_make_it: Can't make it? Just reply to this email and let us know as
soon as you can, so we can find someone else. No hard feelings — life
happens. Leaving it to the morning is the only thing that hurts.
outage_subject: No education reminders went out this morning
outage_body: The site could not read the roster this morning, so
This is almost always Google not answering for a few seconds. The site
retries, and it usually sorts itself out by the next run.
outage_footer: If this arrives two mornings running, tell {{contact}} — that is a real
fault rather than a blip. Anyone who was due a reminder today will need a
nudge_open_roster: Open the roster sheet — put a full name in the Presenter column and everything follows.
playlist_ready: Week {n} — {title} has been added to the chapter playlist, ready for {{weekday}}.
